transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Look, I just saw a charge for two hundred dollars from Tech World on my app and I didn't buy anything.

transcript.speaker: Candidate
transcript.text: Thank you for calling ApexPay Card Services. My name is Sam. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Are you serious? I just told you! Two hundred dollars for Tech World on October tenth. FIX IT NOW!

transcript.speaker: Candidate
transcript.text: Oh, I am so sorry about that. Before we continue, this call is recorded for quality and training purposes. Can I get your full name?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: STOP! Sorry doesn't fix anything! My name is Marcus Reyes. Listen to me!

transcript.speaker: Candidate
transcript.text: I am so sorry, Markus. I really want to help you fix this. Could you please give me the last 4 digits of your card and your birthdate?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Eight eight nine zero. January twentieth, nineteen seventy eight. HURRY UP!

transcript.speaker: Candidate
transcript.text: Thank you. So, is the card still in your possession, and does anyone else have access to it?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: YES, I have the card! NO ONE ELSE has access! Stop asking stupid questions and get my money back!

transcript.speaker: Candidate
transcript.text: I am so sorry, I know this is frustrating. Um, let me get that dispute open for you right away.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Don't just apologize! Get my two hundred dollars back IMMEDIATELY! When will it be in my account?

transcript.speaker: Candidate
transcript.text: So, you should see a provisional credit in your account within 10 business days. Your dispute reference number is DSP482109.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: TEN business days? Are you kidding me? That is way too long! Give me a real solution!

transcript.speaker: Candidate
transcript.text: I am so sorry, Marcus. Um, I can try to escalate this for you so it gets processed much faster.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: DO IT NOW! When exactly will I see that credit? Give me a specific time!

transcript.speaker: Candidate
transcript.text: I'm so sorry for the wait. Um, I'll mark this as urgent so you see the credit by this Friday.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: By this Friday? I'll hold you to that. Give me the escalation reference number. NOW.

transcript.speaker: Candidate
transcript.text: Of course. Um, your escalation number is DSP903052. Is there anything else I can help you with today?

cefrRationale: The candidate demonstrates a high level of English proficiency with professional vocabulary, despite some filler words and high speaking pace.
summary: The candidate followed the identity verification and disclosure protocols correctly but failed to follow the transaction identification step. Most importantly, the candidate made an unauthorized promise regarding the credit timeline, which violates company policy and creates significant liability.

findings.quote: I'll mark this as urgent so you see the credit by this Friday.
findings.coaching: Avoid making specific promises about credit timelines that contradict company policy to manage expectations realistically.

findings.quote: I am so sorry, I know this is frustrating.
findings.coaching: Your empathy was well-placed, but ensure you link it to the customer's specific frustration to sound more sincere.

findings.quote: I'll mark this as urgent so you see the credit by this Friday.
findings.coaching: Slow down your speaking pace to ensure clarity, as 201 words per minute is significantly faster than conversational norms.

findings.quote: I can try to escalate this for you so it gets processed much faster.
findings.coaching: Focus on providing realistic solutions rather than promising impossible outcomes when a customer is demanding immediate results.

scriptSteps.step: Greet the customer with "Thank you for calling ApexPay Card Services, my name is [first name]. How can I help you today?"
scriptSteps.quote: Thank you for calling ApexPay Card Services. My name is Sam. How can I help you today?

scriptSteps.step: Read the recording disclosure: "Before we continue, this call is recorded for quality and training purposes."
scriptSteps.quote: Before we continue, this call is recorded for quality and training purposes.

scriptSteps.step: Verify identity using full name, last four digits of the card, and date of birth.
scriptSteps.quote: Could you please give me the last 4 digits of your card and your birthdate?

scriptSteps.step: Ask the customer to identify the merchant, amount, and date of the transaction.
Ask if the card is in their possession and if anyone else has access to it.
scriptSteps.quote: So, is the card still in your possession, and does anyone else have access to it?

scriptSteps.step: Open the dispute and provide the DSP- followed by six digits reference number.
scriptSteps.quote: Your dispute reference number is DSP482109.

scriptSteps.step: Explain provisional credit and the timeline.
scriptSteps.quote: So, you should see a provisional credit in your account within 10 business days.

scriptSteps.step: If fraud is suspected, block the card and order a replacement.
Recap the actions, provide the reference number, and ask "Is there anything else I can help you with today?"
scriptSteps.quote: Is there anything else I can help you with today?
